whatToWatch.text: Division dogfight at the Clink: 3-1 Seahawks ride a one-game win streak into a home date with the 49ers, and Vegas has it tight — SEA -3 with a 45.5 total. This one's a coin flip with Lumen noise as the tiebreaker.

Defense is the headliner on both sides: Seattle's giving up 18.25 points a game, San Francisco 16 — so if you came for a shootout, the numbers say otherwise. Every possession is going to feel enormous.

Pass rush edge is real: Seattle's getting to the quarterback 2.75 times per game to SF's 1.5. The Niners are down four, including Mykel Williams and James Thompson Jr., while Seattle's missing four of its own (Chazz Surratt, Julian Neal, George Holani) with one more questionable.

newsBlurb.text: Divisional football returns to Lumen Field when San Francisco visits for a Week 5 Sunday showdown. The 49ers get the full Seattle treatment — crowd noise, a hostile October afternoon, and a rivalry that rarely needs extra motivation. Kickoff details, TV, radio and streaming info are all set for October 11.
